sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body: Благодарим вас за предложение. Просим рассмотреть наше встречное предложение.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your prompt response and the proposal for a 24-month contract, which reflects our long-standing partnership. Our foundry takes great pride in our traditions and the close ties we share with our valued partners.

While we are open to extending the contract duration, a 60-day payment term is difficult for our family-run business to accommodate; we propose 45 days as a fair compromise. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms, and our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

For our primary proposal, we offer a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This quote remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. As a family-run foundry that values our long-standing partnership, we rely on constructive and realistic steps to reach an agreement. We therefore maintain our offer of €52.20 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms.

For complete clarity, our offer consists of a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our family business has always taken great pride in supplying your operations with dedication and reliable quality over the years. We firmly believe that this foundation will allow us to find a good way forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
